user.title: Add a lighting curve
user.description: Name the schedule (for example the room). Pick an Adaptive Lighting switch to have the schedule drive its lights. Leave it empty for a schedule that only provides a sensor, for use in your own automations.

error.not_main_switch: Pick the main Adaptive Lighting switch, not its sleep mode or adapt switches.

abort.already_configured: A schedule with this name or switch already exists.
